name: Seek Guard
description: Keeps your resume point when you seek by accident. After a seek, the saved position stays where it was until the new position has actually been watched for a few seconds, so a stray tap on the timeline right before closing the app no longer loses your place.
overview: Ignore accidental seeks when saving playback progress

versions.changelog:
- First release: after a seek, the resume point stays where it was until the new position has been watched.
- Settings for the minimum seek, the watch time needed to confirm a seek, and trusting media segment skips.
